name: Static GRN reconstruction from single-cell foundation models (Ye et al. 2026)
description: Zero-shot GRN reconstruction from six single-cell foundation models with three extraction strategies (token-embedding cosine, hidden-state cosine, attention) against GENIE3, DeepSEM and GRNBoost, on six BEELINE scRNA-seq datasets and four reference network types.

attributes.task: Gene regulatory network inference from single-cell expression
attributes.scope_note: Uses BEELINE datasets and preprocessing with TF-prioritised gene sets (TFs+500, TFs+1000); edges restricted to TF-target candidates and ranked by absolute weight.
attributes.source_locator: Sections 2.1-2.2; Appendix A-B; Tables 4-7

attributes.metric_qualifier: TFs+500 gene set; STRING reference; mean across six datasets

name: Benchmarking Static Gene Regulatory Network Reconstruction and Dynamic Transition Probing in Single-Cell Foundation Models
description: bioRxiv PDF, retrieved and hashed for the 2026-10-11 networks-mechanistic literature pass.

attributes.hash_scope: Exact bytes of one download. bioRxiv serves slightly different PDF bytes per download (41 bytes differed between two downloads 2 minutes apart; pdftotext output identical), so the gzip copy in artifacts/ is the reference.
limitations: Preprint, not peer reviewed.
One run per dataset; the printed spread is the standard deviation across the six datasets, not across runs.
The authors developed none of the evaluated models or baselines.

evidence_concerns.message: Table 1 labels its middle reference column 'ChIP-seq' and the caption names cell-type-specific ChIP-seq, but its values equal the 'Nonspecific ChIP-seq' mean and std rows of Tables 4 and 6 (for example scGPT costok EPR 4.211±1.703), and Appendix B says cell-type-specific ChIP-seq is excluded from the main comparison. Table 1 is therefore not extracted; Tables 4-7 carry the reference labels.
evidence_concerns.source_locator: Table 1 caption and column header; Tables 4 and 6, 'Nonspecific ChIP-seq' mean rows; Appendix B text before Table 4

evidence_concerns.message: Table 6 is titled 'AUPR' and Table 7 'AUPRC', but both print ratios over a random predictor (values above 1), matching the 'AUPRC ratio' of Table 1; both are recorded as auprc-ratio.
evidence_concerns.source_locator: Table 6 and Table 7 captions; Table 1 caption

evidence_concerns.message: Table 7 (TFs+1000 AUPRC) repeats Table 6 (TFs+500 AUPR) exactly in the GENIE3 column of the STRING, Cell-type-specific ChIP-seq and Nonspecific ChIP-seq blocks: all 18 dataset values and the three mean and std rows are identical (for example STRING hESC 1.6241, mean 3.301, std 2.244). Only the OmniPath block differs. Every other column, and GENIE3 in the EPR Tables 4 and 5, differs between the two gene sets, and the Table 6 values match Table 1. These 21 Table 7 GENIE3 values are likely a copy of the TFs+500 values and should not be compared.
evidence_concerns.source_locator: Table 7, column group 'ML', column 'GENIE3', blocks 'STRING', 'Cell-type-specific' and 'Nonspecific'; Table 6, same cells; Table 1, GENIE3 AUPRC ratio

review.method_note: Archived gzip copy unpacked and its SHA-256 matched; a fresh bioRxiv download was rate-limited (HTTP 429).
